prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Image 3 is the APPROVED LOOK of this exact boss in its idle pose (pixel art). Keep the identical design, armour, colours, proportions and size; only the pose changes.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: the Death Eye, exactly as in Image 3: the same colossal undead eyeball bound in torn grey grave cloth, the crown of yellowed bones and small skulls, the huge sickly yellow iris with a black slit pupil, the ghostly pale-violet tendrils trailing below. FACE: the huge yellow iris and slit pupil are the face; no mouth, no other eyes.

Pose: struck: the eye squeezed half shut behind its grave cloth, tilted back away from the heroes, the bone crown knocked askew but still on top, the tendrils curling in, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right, facing right.

MOVEMENT: this is a dramatic ACTION frame of a huge, intimidating boss, not a static stance. Keep the eye facing the viewer as in Image 3, never turned to a side profile; the whole body is knocked back away from the heroes, pushed to the left and tilted back by about fifteen degrees; it stays hovering, nothing touches the ground; the tendrils and grave cloth strips are flung forward toward the heroes by the blow, and trailing parts lag behind the motion. The silhouette must be very different from the idle reference. Any part of the body or weapon may reach beyond the sides of the grey box. BODY: hovering above the ground, nothing touches the ground, no shadow, no water. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a mouth, teeth, eyestalks, a second eye, arms, legs.
